Hi Olivia,

Quick AR checklist so your PO does not get rejected:
- PO must include: exact legal name (match W-8/W-9), billing street address, billing contact email, PO number, renewal start/end dates, currency (USD), and an itemized line for the burst entry with quantity and unit price.
- Please send PO to billing@redwood.com and cc diego_fernandez@redwood.com.
- For a new payor on Net60 we require either: (a) a completed credit app (I can send), or (b) 2 prior invoices paid on Net60 history with Redwood. If neither exists, we provisionally approve Net60 for this renewal provided a credit app is completed and signed before the second invoice.
- Tax: W-8BEN-E (for non-US entities) or W-9 for US entities. For EU VAT, include VAT registration number and invoicing entity.

On invoicing flow: once we receive the PO and tax docs we will create a new billing profile for Nebula Holding, Ltd.; invoices related to the renewal and the July burst will be generated separately but will use the same billing profile and PO reference. The burst will be prorated to the effective days.

Ive attached our AR PO sample and the credit application form. If you want, I can do a short screen-share tomorrow at 9am PT to walk procurement through the fields.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
